BOZMAC PTY LTD, also known as Bozmac Towing Equipment, is looking for a Metal Fabricator to support their operations.

Bozmac is an Australian-owned manufacturer specializing in high-performance towing and recovery equipment, including tilt slide bodies, truck packages, rotators, and towing accessories designed for professional operators across Australia and the South Pacific. Known as the “Tilt Slide Specialists,” the company combines industry experience, innovative engineering, and rigorous testing to deliver durable, reliable, and safe towing solutions built for demanding recovery operations. Based in Hervey Bay, Queensland, Bozmac is recognized for producing functional, heavy-duty equipment backed by quality craftsmanship and a strong reputation within the towing industry. 

To be considered for the role, you need to have a relevant industry qualification or at least 1-2 years' experience in a similar position.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:

-Interpret engineering drawings, fabrication plans and technical specifications to determine manufacturing requirements.
-Select, measure, prepare and mark out steel, aluminium and other metal materials for fabrication.
-Cut, shape, bend and form metal sections using hand tools, power tools and fabrication machinery.
-Fabricate structural components, truck bodies, chassis modifications and towing equipment in accordance with engineering specifications.
-Align, fit and assemble fabricated components using precision measuring instruments and fabrication techniques.
-Join metal components using MIG, TIG and other appropriate welding processes, together with bolting and riveting where required.
-Inspect fabricated components and welded assemblies to ensure dimensional accuracy, weld quality and compliance with engineering specifications.
-Grind, finish, clean and prepare fabricated products for painting, assembly and final installation.
-Operate fabrication equipment safely while maintaining a clean and organised work environment.
-Work collaboratively with the team, supervisors and production staff to ensure 
-Manufacturing deadlines and quality standards are achieved.

If you are a motivated Metal Fabricator with a strong commitment to quality workmanship and manufacturing excellence, we encourage you to apply and become part of the Bozmac team.

Gorski Engineering


Position  : Full Time
Location :  Somerton, VIC
Salary     : $75,000 - $85,000 a year


Established in 1975, proudly Australian, family-owned and operated company, Gorski Engineering is Australia’s leading manufacturer of Premium Tipping Trailers and Tipping Truck Bodies. Experts in both Hardox and Aluminium. 

Gorski Engineering is currently looking for hardworking and dedicated Fitter to join their team.

You should have the skills to:
Accurately read and interpret drawings and specifications.
Operate machines to produce parts by turning, boring, milling, shaping, slotting, grinding or drilling metal stock or components.
Fabrication of all types of steel, aluminium and stainless-steel structures
Plate Profiling, Machining and Lathe jobs
Welding and insulation work
Order/fabricate with accuracy and assemble metal parts.
Assist in equipment maintenance, repair, upgrades and installations.
Perform scheduled inspections and condition assessment on machines.
Maintaining appropriate stock levels of spare parts
Complete tasks to high quality while working to a deadline.

Skills and Experience:
Relevant trade qualification
At least 2 years work experience
Have a strong adherence OH&S and in keeping as safe workplace.
Willing to follow detail instructions and quick Learner.
Be able to perform the physical requirements of the role.

 
If you meet the above criteria, please apply now. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

result.description: Visishta Projects Pty Ltd  The Civil Engineering Technician will assist engineers and project managers in planning, coordinating, monitoring, and delivering civil construction projects. The successful candidate will undertake technical investigations, prepare project documentation, monitor construction activities, conduct site inspections, and ensure works comply with engineering specifications, Australian Standards, and workplace health and safety requirements.  This role is ideal for a technically skilled professional who enjoys working on-site and in the office while contributing to the successful delivery of infrastructure and civil construction projects.   Benefits   Competitive salary package  Full-time permanent employment  Opportunity to work on diverse civil infrastructure and construction projects  Career development and professional growth opportunities  Supportive and collaborative engineering team  Exposure to modern engineering technologies and project management systems  Ongoing training and technical development  Stable long-term employment with a growing civil construction company  Positive workplace culture focused on safety and innovation    Task & responsibilities   Reviewing and interpreting work assignment instructions, determining the correct procedures to follow, and selecting the appropriate equipment for each task  Producing sketches, charts, tabulations, plans and designs for building and construction works, including residential structures, drainage, water supply, sewerage and reticulation systems, driveways, retaining walls and other related structures  Carrying out and overseeing both on-site fieldwork and laboratory testing across construction projects  Gathering and examining data, and performing the necessary calculations and computations  Undertaking field and laboratory tests on construction materials and soils, as well as compiling data for traffic surveys  Preparing estimates of material costs and verifying that completed works comply with specifications, regulations and contract provisions  Examining civil engineering and building works, and arranging and supervising maintenance and repair activities    Qualification & experience   AQF Diploma in Civil Engineering, Engineering Technology, Construction Engineering, or a closely related discipline.   Minimum one (1) year of relevant full-time experience  as a Civil Engineering Technician or in a similar role supporting civil engineering or construction projects.  Alternatively, relevant industry experience may be considered where appropriate under ANZSCO requirements.  Demonstrated experience supporting civil engineering or construction projects.  Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and technical documentation.  Knowledge of civil construction methods, materials, and engineering principles.  Proficiency in Microsoft Office and engineering software such as AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Bluebeam, or similar applications.  Strong analytical, organisational, and problem-solving skills.  Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.  Commitment to workplace health and safety and quality assurance.   About Company     Visishta Projects Pty Ltd  is a Queensland-based civil construction and project management company headquartered in  Sunnybank Hills, Brisbane . The company delivers high-quality civil engineering, infrastructure, earthworks, roadworks, drainage, utility, and construction solutions for public and private sector clients. With a strong commitment to quality, safety, innovation, and sustainable project delivery, Visishta Projects Pty Ltd has established a reputation for delivering projects on time, within budget, and to the highest industry standards.
